name: Vampire - Regeneration - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a feature

results.text: The vampire gasps in agony as holy fire scorches its essence, halting its unholy recovery.
A searing light burns away the dark magic, leaving its wounds gaping and raw.
The sacred water hisses on its skin, rendering its cursed vitality useless against divine wrath.
Radiant energy flares within, scalding his veins as the regeneration fails him.
Sunlight’s cruel touch steals the night’s blessing, leaving him broken and defenseless.
